items.title: After Indexing is Correct: Hash Join Spills, Splitting Joins Without N+1 & 4 UPSERT Traps
items.description: Advanced database query optimization when indexes are already optimal: Hash Join memory spills to disk, the art of application-side joins without N+1, deterministic SELECT-then-write ID ordering, and 4 dangerous traps of ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.

items.title: Backup & Recovery
items.description: RPO, RTO, backup strategies, point-in-time recovery, logical vs physical backups, and disaster recovery planning.

items.title: Database Isolation Levels — How to Get It Right
items.description: Deep-dive into all 5 isolation anomalies (dirty read, non-repeatable, phantom, lost update, write skew), the 4 standard isolation levels, PostgreSQL vs MySQL vs Oracle implementation differences, snapshot scope (per-statement vs per-transaction), practical fix strategies without raising isolation, and the spec vs implementation distinction.

items.title: Exporting 5 Million Rows Without Killing the Database: Keyset Seek, JDBC Buffers & net_write_timeout
items.description: Physical engine mechanics of large-scale database exports: why LIMIT OFFSET degrades linearly, keyset pagination pitfalls, Go streaming vs Java JDBC OutOfMemoryError, and an anatomy of the net_write_timeout socket failure.

items.title: How Long Transactions Kill Services: Undo Log Bloat, Rollback Traps & The MDL Cascade
items.description: Physical mechanisms of long-running transaction failures: Undo tablespace and History List Length (HLL) bloat, the single-threaded rollback trap, the critical difference between KILL QUERY and KILL CONNECTION, and the Metadata Lock (MDL) queue cascade exhausting connection pools.

items.title: Inventory Reservations at Scale: Why Shopify Moved from Redis to MySQL
items.description: Deep dive into high-concurrency inventory reservation architectures — why Redis dual-writes cause overselling and underselling, how MySQL 8 SKIP LOCKED eliminates row contention, and how Shopify scaled to $5.1M GMV/minute during Black Friday.

items.title: MySQL Indexing Vượt Qua Dấu Bằng: ORDER BY, Range Scans, ICP & Deferred Joins
items.description: Chi tiết cơ chế đánh index MySQL nâng cao: phân biệt Seek vs Filter, quy tắc Leftmost Prefix, ESR rule, Index Condition Pushdown (ICP), Skip Scan, và kỹ thuật Deferred Join tăng tốc 148 lần.

items.title: Online DDL: Adding Indexes Safely in Production — ALGORITHM Matrix, Row Log & gh-ost vs pt-osc
items.description: Online Schema Change mechanics in MySQL and PostgreSQL: why staging finishes in 40s while production exhausts connection pools, ALGORITHM & LOCK matrix, innodb_online_alter_log_max_size overflow, gh-ost vs pt-osc, and PostgreSQL's INVALID index trap.

items.title: Why You Deadlock Touching Only 1 Row: Gap Locks & The 3 Access Paths of WHERE
items.description: Deep dive into MySQL InnoDB storage engine locking mechanics: why two users updating distinct draft carts trigger Deadlock 1213, decoding the 3 access paths of a WHERE clause, and why READ COMMITTED won't save you.
